title: A refined 1-cocycle for regular isotopies and the refined tangle equations
summary: We refine the combinatorial 1-cocycle $\mathbb{L}R_{reg}$ for regular isotopies of long knots to a 1-cocycle with values in the free $\mathbb{Z}[x,x^{-1}]$-module generated by regular isotopy classes of oriented tangles with exactly one signed ordinary double point. We use it to define the refined tangle equations for couples of knot diagrams, where the coefficients are now Laurent polynomials instead of integers.
